# Course skills (stage instructions)

These folders are the Devpost Learn "Build With AI: Basics" course skills, copied unchanged
from https://github.com/challengepost/learn-ai-basics (MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026
Devpost; see LICENSE in this folder). The guide reads them as its stage instructions:
Start (1-start), Idea (2-scope), Design (3-prd) and Tech plan (4-spec). 5-build is kept for
the build-planning step. Sections about terminals, git and folders are skipped when the
prompt is built (server/journey/stages.ts).
